Definition: properly, flavor; figuratively, judgment (both subjective and objective); hence, account (both subjectively and objectively)
BiblicalUsage: The word is a decree, a command, and also the taste or sense of a thing, in Aramaic. Nebuchadnezzar made a decree that every man hearing the music should fall down and worship the golden image; the king of Persia commanded a search concerning Jerusalem; and Artaxerxes made a decree that all of the people of Israel who were minded to go up to Jerusalem might go with Ezra.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that kings decree and God overrules, and the decree that set Ezra free undid the decree that stopped the work.
